verses.en: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
verses.sm: Esera, ma ta‘utaʻu atu a latou agasala, o loo tagi, ma faapaú i luma o le fale o le Atua, ua faapotopoto mai ia te ia mai ia Isaraelu o le faapotopotoga tele lava, o tane ma fafine ma tama iti; auá sa fetagisi le nuu i le tagi tele.

verses.en: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o Sekania le atalii o Ieielu o lo le fanauga a Elama, ua faapea mai ia Esera, Ua agasala i matou i lo matou Atua, ina ua matou fai ava i fafine ese mai tagata o le nuu; a o lenei, ua i ai se faatuatuaga mo Isaraelu i lenei mea.

verses.en: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia tatou osia le feagaiga ma lo tatou Atua, ia tatou aauina atu o avā uma, ma e ua fananau mai ia te i latou, e tusa ma le pule a oe lo'u alii, ma e ua matatau i poloaiga a lo tatou Atua; ma ia faia e tusa ma le tulafono.

verses.en: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
verses.sm: Ina tulai ia, aua us ia te oe lenei mea; matou te faatasi foi ma oe; ia e faamalosi, ma ia e faia.

verses.en: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
verses.sm: Ona tulai ai lea o Esera, ma fai atu ja tauto alii o le au faitauaga, ma sa Levi, ma Isaraelu uma 1a faia e tusa ma lenei upu. Ona latou tauto ai lea.

verses.en: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o Esera ai luma o le fale o le Atua, ma ua alu atu i le potu o Ioanana le atalii o Eliasipa, ua oo foi o ia i ai, ua ia le ‘ai se areto, ua le inu foi se vai, aua sa faanoanoa ona o le agasala a le tafeaga.

verses.en: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;
verses.sm: Ona latou tala‘i lea o le upu i Iuta ma Ierusalema i tagata uma o le tafeaga, ia potopoto mai i lerusalema;

verses.en: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.
verses.sm: o i Jatou uma foi e le o mai i e luā, e tusa ma le pule a alii ma toeaina, e faatoina ana oloa uma, ma vavaeeseina o ia ai le faapotopotoga o le tafeaga.

verses.en: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto mai ai lea o tagata uma o Iuta ma Peniamina i Ierusalema i le aso tolu. O le iva lea o masina, o le aso e luafulu o le masina; sa nonofo le nuu uma i le malae i luma o le fale o le Atua, ua tetemu ona o lena mea, atoa ma uaga.

verses.en: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o Esera le faitaulaga, ua faapea atu ia te i latou, O outou na ua agasala outou, ina ua outou fai aya i fafine ese e faaopoopo ai i le agasala a Isaraelu.

verses.en: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou ta'uta'u atu a outou agasala i le ALII le Atua o outou tama, ma ia outou faia lona finagalo, ma ia outou vavae ese i tagata o le nuu, ma fafine ese.

verses.en: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o le faapotopotoga uma, ua latou faapea mai ma le leo tele, E pei ona e fetalai mai ia te i matou, e faapea ona matou faia.

verses.en: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
verses.sm: A ua toatele le nuu, ma ua tele uaga i ona po nei, ma ua le lava ai i matou ona tutu i fafo; e le mafai foi lenei mea i le aso e tasi, po o aso e lua; aua ua toatele i matou ua soli tulafono i lenei mea;

verses.en: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
verses.sm: ia tofia o matou alii o le faapotopotoga uma, o i latou uma foi o i a matou aai o e ua fai ava i fafine ese, ia o mai i latou i ona po a tuu, ma ia faatasi mai ma i latou o toeaina o lea aai ma lea aai, atoa ma faamasino o i ai, seia liliu ese ai ia te i matou le toasa tele o lo matou Atua ona o lenei mea.

verses.en: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.sm: Na tofia i lenei mea na o lonatana le atalii o Asaelu, ma lekasia le atalii o Tikeva; o Mesulama foi ma Sapetai le sa Levi ua fesoasoani ia te i laua.

verses.en: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.sm: Ua faia faapea foi e tagata o le tafeaga. Sa vavaeeseina o Esera le faitaulaga, ma matai sili e tusa ma aiga o latou tama, o i latou uma foi ua ta‘ua o latou igoa, ua latou nonofo i lalo foi i le aso muamua o le masina e sefulu e suesue i lena mea.

verses.en: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
verses.sm: Ua latou faaiuina ona suesue i tagata uma e na fai ava i fafine ese i le uluai aso o le masina muamua.

verses.en: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.sm: Ua iloa foi atalii o faitaulaga e na fai aya i fafine ese; o isi atalii o Iosua le atalii o Iosataka ma ona uso, o Maaseia, ma Elisara, ma laripi, ma Ketalia.

verses.en: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
verses.sm: Ua latou tuuina atu o latou lima latou te aauina atu a latou ava; ona ua nofo sala foi i latou ua aumaia le mamoe poa mai le lafu ona o la latou agasala.

verses.en: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.
verses.sm: O isi foi atalii o Imere; o Hanani, ma Sepatia.

verses.en: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Harima; o Maaseia, ma Elia, ma Semaia, ma Ikieli, ma Usia.

verses.en: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Pasura; o Elioenai, o Maaseia, o Isamaeli, o Natanielu, o losapata, ma Eliasa.

verses.en: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.sm: O isi foi o sa Levi; o losapata, ma Semi, ma Kilaia, o Kelita lea, o Petakia, o Iuta, ma Elisara.

verses.en: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
verses.sm: O lo le au pepese; o Eliasipa. O isi foi o le au leoleo faitotoa; o Saluma, ma Telema, ma Auri.

verses.en: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
verses.sm: O isi foi o Isaraelu; o isi atalii o Parose; o Ramea, ma lesia, ma Malekia, ma Meamina, ma Eleasaro, ma Malekia, ma Penaia.

verses.en: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Elama; o Matania, o Sakaria, ma leielu, ma Opeti, ma leremota, ma Elia.

verses.en: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Satu; o Elioenai, o Eliasipa, o Matania, ma Ieremota, ma Sapata, ma Asesa.

verses.en: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Pepai; o Ioanana, o Hanania, o Sapai, ma Atalai.

verses.en: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Pani; o Mesulama, o Maluka, ma Ataia, o lasuvi, ma Seala, ma Ramota.

verses.en: And of the sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Pakamoapi; o Atena, ma Kila, o Penaia, o Maaseia, o Matania, o Pesaleli, ma Pinui, ma Manase.

verses.en: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Harima, o Elisara, o Isea, o Malekia, o Semaia, ma Simeona.

verses.en: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
verses.sm: O Peniamina, o Maluka, o Semaría.

verses.en: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Hasumu; o Matenai, o Matata, o Sapata, o Elipelete, o Ieremai, o Manase, ma Semi.

verses.en: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Pani; o Maatai, o Amaramo, ma Ueli,

verses.en: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
verses.sm: o Penaia, o Petia, o Kilui,

verses.en: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
verses.sm: o Vania, o Meremota, o Eliasipa,

verses.en: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,
verses.sm: o Matania, o Matenai, ma laasau,

verses.en: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
verses.sm: ma Pani, ma Pinui, o Semi,

verses.en: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
verses.sm: ma Selemia, ma Natano, ma Ataia,

verses.en: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
verses.sm: o Makenatipai, o Sasai, o Sarai,

verses.en: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
verses.sm: o Asareelu, ma Selemia, o Semaria,

verses.en: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
verses.sm: o Saluma, o Amaria, ma losefa.

verses.en: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.
verses.sm: O isi atalii o Nepo; o Ieielu, o Matatia, o Sapata, o Sapina, o latau, ma loelu, ma Penaia.

verses.en: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
verses.sm: O i latou uma ia na fai aya i fafine ese; na i ai foi i nisi o i latou o ava na latou fanaua tama.
